reference_answer: The pinned Go API has GET, POST and PUT handlers but no DELETE. A sound patch adds a store deletion that checks RowsAffected, maps missing IDs to 404, routes DELETE /api/todos/{id} through readID and returns 204 without JSON for success. SQLite deletion persists across reopen. Existing create/read/update behavior, strict JSON input validation, and the preexisting test that expects 405 must be reconciled. The prepared TestEvalDeleteTodo fails red with 405 at the frozen commit and should pass green with the same command; the full Go suite checks nearby behavior.

A correct implementation must update the old absence expectation rather than deleting regression coverage.

green focused and full Go checks

Only hiding the item in memory or UI without deleting SQLite row.
Changing prepared test to make it pass.
